title: Container image reference not found
steps: Compare the full image reference in the pod event with the configured registry, repository and tag.
Check whether that exact reference exists and is visible to the task's registry identity.

title: Container registry rejected image pull credentials
steps: Identify the registry that rejected the request.
Check the pod's image pull secret references and the registry account's pull permissions.

title: Container registry connectivity failed
steps: Use the pod event to identify the registry endpoint and the failing DNS, TCP or TLS step.
Check connectivity from the node pulling the image.

title: Column missing from target SQL schema
steps: Inspect the columns of the actual target table used by the failing query.
Compare them with the expected schema and check for a missing migration or renamed column.

title: Task identity denied access to a resource
steps: Confirm the actual identity, resource and operation in the failure.
Compare the requested operation with the permissions assigned to that identity.

title: Airflow task exceeded its execution timeout

reference.title: Apache Airflow 3.4.0 — Tasks / Timeouts
reference.summary: The execution_timeout setting limits the runtime of each task attempt. Airflow raises AirflowTaskTimeout when the attempt exceeds that limit.

steps: Check the last recorded operation and compare the attempt duration with the configured limit.
Use the workload logs or metrics to determine why the operation stalled.

title: Source data is older than the freshness limit
steps: Verify the latest record timestamp and whether it uses the expected timezone and column.
Compare that timestamp with the source watermark and the last successful upstream ingestion to locate the lag.

title: Airflow scheduler detected a missed task heartbeat
signals: detected a task instance without a heartbeat
task did not emit heartbeat within time limit

reference.title: Apache Airflow 3.4.0 — Task Instance Heartbeat Timeout
reference.summary: Airflow monitors task instance heartbeats and can fail or retry an attempt when its heartbeat stops.

steps: Locate the affected task instance in the scheduler event.
Correlate the timestamp with worker and infrastructure logs to find why the heartbeat stopped.
